This plot is small and rented, so I will not waste money buying chemical fertilizer for it. I will spread cow dung on the soil as my father taught me, and I will sow the sorghum seed I kept from my last harvest. The rains will water the crop, and my family will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since the land is not big.
